title: UDF (Universal Disk Format) signature
summary: A UDF filesystem has the signature 'BEA01' (0x42 0x45 0x41 0x30 0x31) at sector 32 (offset 65536) in the beginning extended area descriptor.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: UDF is used for DVD, Blu-ray, and optical media.
UDF supports large files (>4GB), long filenames, and packet writing.
UDF is the successor to ISO 9660 for optical media.
